Project 
Profile

Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM)
Clients :1. SMRT (SG)
2.Singapore Power(SG)
Technology Used: ASP.Net, C#, WCF Service, Windows Service, Work Flow Service, .Net Framework 4.5, Sql Server 2012, JavaScript, IIS 8.5, AJAX.
Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM) is a solution that provides a 'layered approach' to identity governance and administration. Deep IACM does this by discovering deep into applications, databases and systems, where users and their access permissions are stored. While the typical process of discovering users' access is just to determine whether the users were given specific access rights, Deep IACM, adopting 'layered approach', penetrates deeper to bridge the link between all the layers. This information is used for downstream processes such as attestation, compliance, role management, audit and reporting. It provides solutions addressing full range of compliance requirements such as excessive access rights, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, Sensitive accesses and identity and access violations. These compliance checks are in built into Deep IACM and are available out of the box. Policy adherence is checked and Deep IACM produces results for policy violations, reviews, risk scoring, reports and dashboards.
Responsibilities:
Was involved developing MAS DB connector, Access request, Work flow Module, Attestation Module, Non-Connected systems module and various customized reports.
Co-ordinate with On-site team and gather requirements and delivered on time.
Worked in Client office during IDMS UAT in SMRT Singapore.
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM)
Client: Ctrl s
Technology Used: ASP.Net MVC, C#, Web API, Web Service, Windows Service, .Net Framework 4.5, SQL Server 2012, java script, IIS 8.5, AJAX and Node.js
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM) provides comprehensive logging and recording of the privilege identity session. This logging and recording is done at the PIM-Gateway Server which acts as proxy for all access to target servers. Privilege Command Manager logs are text based and stored in SQL database while the Secure Desktop Connection Manager logs are compressed and stored on the PIM-Gateway Server. Secure Desktop functionality supports Microsoft Servers for privilege remote access. This secure desktop access allows users to connect to any windows servers without the need to know the privilege identity password of the target servers. Users can use their standard browsers to connect to target servers via the PIM-Gateway Server and have complete access to windows desktop and applications on the target windows server. Secure Desktop Connection Manager also manages session for concurrent access, termination of session and monitor idle session. Privilege Command Manager also provides additional policies to restrict list of commands that can be allowed along with its path and which users were allowed to execute them and on which server. Responsibilities:
development of various modules within the application, developing web APIs, java script front-end validations, development of reports, writing AJAX calls, build and hosting activities for the application and other team co-ordination activities.

Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM)

Technology Used: ASP.Net, C#, WCF Service, Windows Service, Work Flow Service, .Net Framework 4.5, Sql Server 2012, JavaScript, IIS 8.5, AJAX.
Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM) is a solution that provides a 'layered approach' to identity governance and administration. Deep IACM does this by discovering deep into applications, databases and systems, where users and their access permissions are stored. While the typical process of discovering users' access is just to determine whether the users were given specific access rights, Deep IACM, adopting 'layered approach', penetrates deeper to bridge the link between all the layers. This information is used for downstream processes such as attestation, compliance, role management, audit and reporting. It provides solutions addressing full range of compliance requirements such as excessive access rights, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, Sensitive accesses and identity and access violations. These compliance checks are in built into Deep IACM and are available out of the box. Policy adherence is checked and Deep IACM produces results for policy violations, reviews, risk scoring, reports and dashboards.
Responsibilities:
Was involved developing MAS DB connector, Access request, Work flow Module, Attestation Module, Non-Connected systems module and various customized reports.
Co-ordinate with On-site team and gather requirements and delivered on time.
Worked in Client office during IDMS UAT in SMRT Singapore.
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM)
Client: Ctrl s
Technology Used: ASP.Net MVC, C#, Web API, Web Service, Windows Service, .Net Framework 4.5, SQL Server 2012, java script, IIS 8.5, AJAX and Node.js
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM) provides comprehensive logging and recording of the privilege identity session. This logging and recording is done at the PIM-Gateway Server which acts as proxy for all access to target servers. Privilege Command Manager logs are text based and stored in SQL database while the Secure Desktop Connection Manager logs are compressed and stored on the PIM-Gateway Server. Secure Desktop functionality supports Microsoft Servers for privilege remote access. This secure desktop access allows users to connect to any windows servers without the need to know the privilege identity password of the target servers. Users can use their standard browsers to connect to target servers via the PIM-Gateway Server and have complete access to windows desktop and applications on the target windows server. Secure Desktop Connection Manager also manages session for concurrent access, termination of session and monitor idle session. Privilege Command Manager also provides additional policies to restrict list of commands that can be allowed along with its path and which users were allowed to execute them and on which server. Responsibilities:
development of various modules within the application, developing web APIs, java script front-end validations, development of reports, writing AJAX calls, build and hosting activities for the application and other team co-ordination activities.

Project Overview
Project #1:
Organization : Plintron Global Technology Solutions Private Limited
Project Name: DSM
DataBase :SQL Server 2008
Environment: ASP.Net webform,MVC, ADO.Net, WCF and Win Services
Duration: Sep 2015- Till Date
Project Description:
Plintron DSM portal contains various modules like Retailers, Resellers, Wholesaler, Service provider and Admin Module.
This is a web based application to maintain the process of LYCAMOBILE Sales and management Distribution Sales Managements (DSM) application in the Plintron MVNE platform enables the MVNOs to manage the SIMs and Vouchers distribution process to the retailers without any hassle.
The SIMs and voucher details are uploaded on various applications in the MVNE platform. Once the upload process is completed, the SIMs and Vouchers must be distributed to the retailers. The retailer in turn can sell the stock (SIMs and vouchers) to subscribers.
The retailer can also do top-up for subscribers. The stock and top-up amount will be allocated to users in the DSM application and finally allocated to retailers. The stock and top-up allocation process undergoes several authentication processes to make sure that they are efficiently distributed to the retailers and subscribers.
Also, the MVNO can define incentives to various levels of users in the DSM application. Based on the stock sold to the subscribers, each user-levels involved in the stock distribution process will get the respective incentive.
In the similar way, the excess stock must be returned back to the subsequent high-level user in order to ensure that the stock is not getting stagnated at one user-level.
The Distribution process goes like below steps,
Wholesaler
Branch Office
Head Office
Sub-Wholesaler
Retailers
Roles and Responsibility:
Requirement Analysis and effort estimation

Production support

Updated Daily status in Development tracker tool and shared the same to teams, Project Leads and Managers.
Project #2:
Organization: Plintron Global Technology Solutions Private Limited
Project Name: CBOS
Environment: ASP.Net , ADO.NET, WCF and Win Services.
Duration: Sep 2014- Nov 2015
The MVNO can use Plintron CBOS application to manage MVNO's business and network -related tasks
The MVNO procures SIM cards from the SIM vendors and generates required number of vouchers using the VoMS application. Then, the MVNO can upload the SIMs and vouchers in the CBOS application for assigning the SIMs and vouchers to the reseller and in turn to the retailers. The retailer sells the SIMs and vouchers to the subscribers.
The subscriber can register SIM details with the MVNO. Subscriber registration process is mandatory only for some countries. Once the customer registers the SIM details and personal details with the MVNO, the SIM will be activated and the subscriber can use MVNO's network services.
The MVNO can use CBOS application for the following:
SIM management
Voucher management
Reseller management
Project #3:
Project Name: CRBOS
Environment: ASP.Net , ADO.Net
The MVNO can create resellers in the CBOS application and provide user credentials for resellers to access the RBOS application. The reseller can access the RBOS application to create new retailers and distributors.
The retailer is an organisation or an individual merchant that purchases SIMs from the reseller or wholesale partner and sell the SIMs directly to the subscribers.
The reseller can sell the SIM cards directly to subscribers or can create distributor (child-user) to sell reseller's SIM to subscribers. The reseller can assign a part of or complete reseller's SIM to distributors. The subscribers can approach resellers or distributors to purchase SIM cards.
After purchasing a SIM, the subscriber can call the MVNO's CSR to register the SIM details. Once the customer registers the SIM details and personal details with the MVNO, the SIM will be activated and the subscriber can use MVNO's network services.

Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM) is a solution that provides a 'layered approach' to identity governance and administration. Deep IACM does this by discovering deep into applications, databases and systems, where users and their access permissions are stored. While the typical process of discovering users' access is just to determine whether the users were given specific access rights, Deep IACM, adopting 'layered approach', penetrates deeper to bridge the link between all the layers. This information is used for downstream processes such as attestation, compliance, role management, audit and reporting. It provides solutions addressing full range of compliance requirements such as excessive access rights, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, Sensitive accesses and identity and access violations. These compliance checks are in built into Deep IACM and are available out of the box. Policy adherence is checked and Deep IACM produces results for policy violations, reviews, risk scoring, reports and dashboards.

Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM)
Client: Ctrl s
Technology Used: ASP.Net MVC, C#, Web API, Web Service, Windows Service, .Net Framework 4.5, SQL Server 2012, java script, IIS 8.5, AJAX and Node.js
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM) provides comprehensive logging and recording of the privilege identity session. This logging and recording is done at the PIM-Gateway Server which acts as proxy for all access to target servers. Privilege Command Manager logs are text based and stored in SQL database while the Secure Desktop Connection Manager logs are compressed and stored on the PIM-Gateway Server. Secure Desktop functionality supports Microsoft Servers for privilege remote access. This secure desktop access allows users to connect to any windows servers without the need to know the privilege identity password of the target servers. Users can use their standard browsers to connect to target servers via the PIM-Gateway Server and have complete access to windows desktop and applications on the target windows server. Secure Desktop Connection Manager also manages session for concurrent access, termination of session and monitor idle session. Privilege Command Manager also provides additional policies to restrict list of commands that can be allowed along with its path and which users were allowed to execute them and on which server. Responsibilities:
development of various modules within the application, developing web APIs, java script front-end validations, development of reports, writing AJAX calls, build and hosting activities for the application and other team co-ordination activities.

A technical writer who has gained some 
experience
 with companies often provides job 
training
 to newer writers.
And, technical writers work with many different groups of people while developing content.
A part of this 
training
 involves creating technical documents based on guidelines that the senior writers develop
according to ongoing technical documents' needs.
The guidelines themselves are an essential part of how technical writers work at their company. Depending on
the hierarchy, they may also lead the company to create better, more efficient guidelines for future technical
writers' work efforts.
Additionally, the content guidelines for any business need updating alongside changing business goals and
requirements.
Senior technical content strategists are the point people to better develop new guidelines to reflect new business
goals as central technical communicators.
If you're interested in learning more about the technical writing 
skills
, roles, and path to landing your dream
technical writing job, then check out our Technical Writing Certification Course.

Writing for the more technology-oriented technical areas is like any other form of industry-based writing. The only difference is
the requirement for tech-savvy individuals in the writer's position.
The computer science and information technology sector places writers within the systems design and analysis field. These
writers are often closer to the system than most technical writers are to the subject they are writing on. This is because they
take a deep dive into the system to articulate its specifics clearly. Most technical writers may not need to engage scientific and
technical products so immediately.
CS/IT writers are prime examples of content developers who can transform extremely complex industry jargon into
understandable content for the masses.
An example is Microsoft's product description writers, who simplify their language to the point where people can still
understand the product without much software knowledge.
Technical writers in computers and IT have a technical skill requirement that includes:
Proven expertise with the systems
Thorough understanding of computer science concepts along with some 
experience
 in IT systems administration
Knowledge of the corporate IT sector and how modern companies leverage technology
An ability to prepare technical material for both students and administrators
Some 
experience
 in writing on CS/IT subjects either during the educational process or subsequent internships
Writing in computer science requires someone who has either worked directly as part of an IT department or has taken an
eLearning course on how to write for the industry.

Project 
Profile

Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM)
Clients :1. SMRT (SG)
2.Singapore Power(SG)
Technology Used: ASP.Net, C#, WCF Service, Windows Service, Work Flow Service, .Net Framework 4.5, Sql Server 2012, JavaScript, IIS 8.5, AJAX.
Identity Audit & Compliance Manager (Deep IACM) is a solution that provides a 'layered approach' to identity governance and administration. Deep IACM does this by discovering deep into applications, databases and systems, where users and their access permissions are stored. While the typical process of discovering users' access is just to determine whether the users were given specific access rights, Deep IACM, adopting 'layered approach', penetrates deeper to bridge the link between all the layers. This information is used for downstream processes such as attestation, compliance, role management, audit and reporting. It provides solutions addressing full range of compliance requirements such as excessive access rights, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, Sensitive accesses and identity and access violations. These compliance checks are in built into Deep IACM and are available out of the box. Policy adherence is checked and Deep IACM produces results for policy violations, reviews, risk scoring, reports and dashboards.
Responsibilities:
Was involved developing MAS DB connector, Access request, Work flow Module, Attestation Module, Non-Connected systems module and various customized reports.
Co-ordinate with On-site team and gather requirements and delivered on time.
Worked in Client office during IDMS UAT in SMRT Singapore.
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM)
Client: Ctrl s
Technology Used: ASP.Net MVC, C#, Web API, Web Service, Windows Service, .Net Framework 4.5, SQL Server 2012, java script, IIS 8.5, AJAX and Node.js
Privilege Identity Manager (Deep PIM) provides comprehensive logging and recording of the privilege identity session. This logging and recording is done at the PIM-Gateway Server which acts as proxy for all access to target servers. Privilege Command Manager logs are text based and stored in SQL database while the Secure Desktop Connection Manager logs are compressed and stored on the PIM-Gateway Server. Secure Desktop functionality supports Microsoft Servers for privilege remote access. This secure desktop access allows users to connect to any windows servers without the need to know the privilege identity password of the target servers. Users can use their standard browsers to connect to target servers via the PIM-Gateway Server and have complete access to windows desktop and applications on the target windows server. Secure Desktop Connection Manager also manages session for concurrent access, termination of session and monitor idle session. Privilege Command Manager also provides additional policies to restrict list of commands that can be allowed along with its path and which users were allowed to execute them and on which server. Responsibilities:
development of various modules within the application, developing web APIs, java script front-end validations, development of reports, writing AJAX calls, build and hosting activities for the application and other team co-ordination activities.
